audit.whatIsWrong: Content repeatedly describes an 'E blink through her wall' and 'R banish-zone/displacement' — on the current kit E (The Weirding, 15-11s) is a slow blast with a backward hop, her escape is W (Across the Veil, 22-18s leap + invisibility), and R (Between Worlds) is a shockwave slow plus a zone she teleports across; nothing banishes. 'E charges' claim also false (flat CD). Full layer referenced a nonexistent 'silence' and had no cooldown digits. Aurora P spirits heal her — anti-heal timing was unmentioned (missing-interactions feed).
audit.why: Riot kit text for W/E/R; P heal flag; feed rule needs-antiheal.
audit.corrected: All blink/banish/charge language replaced with hop/zone facts; Executioner's timing added to breakdown.early; 22s/15s numbers added.
